about: One verse a day. Each weekday draws from its own deity's pool (day 0 = Sunday/Surya ... 6 = Saturday/Bhairav), rotating week by week, so a verse returns about every fourteen weeks. Devanagari is the source of truth; the Roman line is generated from it (add "tr" only for Hindi/Awadhi verses, where the Sanskrit rules would mispronounce them). English and "carry" lines are original wording.

items.sa:
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः ।
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि ।
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
items.en: We meditate on the radiant light of the divine Sun. May it awaken and guide our minds.
items.carry: Start with one clear intention before the first task.

items.sa:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
items.en: Lift yourself by your own effort; do not let yourself sink. You alone are your own friend, and you alone are your own enemy.
items.carry: Be your own friend today: do the thing you have been avoiding.

items.sa:
असतो मा सद्गमय ।
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मामृतं गमय ॥
items.en: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light, from death to immortality.
items.carry: At each small choice today, take the clearer, truer option.

items.src: Aditya Hridayam 5 · Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 107 (sarga 105 in other editions)
items.sa:
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ।
चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ॥
items.en: This hymn is the most auspicious of all that is auspicious: it destroys every sin, calms worry and grief, and lengthens life. It is the best.
items.carry: Stand in the daylight for a minute and let the worry settle.

items.sa:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः ।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः ॥
items.en: Do your allotted work, for action is better than inaction. Even the upkeep of your body is impossible without action.
items.carry: Action beats waiting for motivation. Begin the first block.

items.sa: आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतः ॥
items.en: May noble thoughts come to us from every side.
items.carry: Let one good idea in today: a page, a walk, a conversation.

items.sa:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
items.en: Among the Adityas I am Vishnu; among lights, the radiant Sun; among the Maruts I am Marichi; among the stars, the Moon.
items.carry: Notice one thing today that is simply brilliant, and say thanks.

items.sa:
सत्यं वद ।
धर्मं चर ।
स्वाध्यायान्मा प्रमदः ॥
items.en: Speak the truth. Follow dharma. Do not neglect your own study.
items.carry: Say one true thing clearly today, and read a little.

items.sa:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
items.en: For one who is moderate in food and recreation, in effort and in work, and in sleep and waking, yoga destroys sorrow.
items.carry: Keep today in balance: regular meals, steady effort, sleep on time.

items.sa:
उत्तिष्ठत जाग्रत प्राप्य वरान्निबोधत ।
क्षुरस्य धारा निशिता दुरत्यया दुर्गं पथस्तत्कवयो वदन्ति ॥
items.en: Arise, awake; approach the wise and understand. The path is sharp as a razor's edge, hard to cross, say the sages.
items.carry: Stand up and begin. The path is narrow, so take one step.

items.sa: सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च ॥
items.en: The Sun is the soul of all that moves and all that stands still.
items.carry: Step into the daylight for ten minutes today.

items.src: Bhagavad Gita 13.34 (13.33 in Gita Press numbering)
items.sa:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः ।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥
items.en: As the one sun lights up this whole world, so the knower of the field lights up the whole field, O Bharata.
items.carry: Watch the awareness behind your thoughts, not only the thoughts.

items.sa:
ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् ।
तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ॥
items.en: All this, whatever moves in the world, is pervaded by the Lord. Enjoy through renunciation; do not covet anyone's wealth.
items.carry: Enjoy what you already have today, and measure it against no one.

items.sa:
सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्ये धर्मः सदाश्रितः ।
सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम् ॥
items.en: Truth alone is God in this world; dharma always rests on truth. Everything has truth as its root; there is no higher state than truth.
items.carry: Be as honest in small things as in big ones.

items.sa:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
items.en: We worship the three-eyed one, fragrant, who nourishes all. As a ripe cucumber is freed from its stem, may he free us from death, but not from immortality.
items.carry: Loosen one worry you are gripping today; it is ripe to fall.

items.sa:
नागेन्द्रहाराय त्रिलोचनाय भस्माङ्गरागाय महेश्वराय ।
नित्याय शुद्धाय दिगम्बराय तस्मै नकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥
items.en: Salutations to Shiva, the syllable 'Na': garlanded with the king of serpents, three-eyed, smeared with ash, the great Lord, eternal, pure, clothed in the sky.
items.carry: Say 'Om Namah Shivaya' once, slowly, before you start.

items.sa:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः ।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे ॥
items.en: The Self is never born and never dies; having come to be, it does not cease to be. Unborn, eternal, ancient, it is not killed when the body is killed.
items.carry: Whatever happens to today's plans, the Self underneath is untouched.

items.sa:
मनोबुद्ध्यहङ्कारचित्तानि नाहं न च श्रोत्रजिह्वे न च घ्राणनेत्रे ।
न च व्योमभूमिर्न तेजो न वायुश्चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
items.en: I am not mind, intellect, ego or memory; not ears, tongue, nose or eyes; not sky, earth, fire or air. I am consciousness and bliss: I am Shiva, I am Shiva.
items.carry: You are more than today's score. Start from there.

items.sa:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः ।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत ॥
items.en: Contacts of the senses with their objects give cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They come and go and do not last; endure them, O Bharata.
items.carry: Stay with the discomfort of the hard part; it will pass.

items.sa:
नमः शम्भवे च मयोभवे च
नमः शङ्कराय च मयस्कराय च
नमः शिवाय च शिवतराय च ॥
items.en: Salutations to the source of happiness and the maker of happiness; to the doer of good and the maker of joy; to the auspicious one and to the still more auspicious.
items.carry: Leave one thing a little better than you found it.

items.sa:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः ।
वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते ॥
items.en: One whose mind is not shaken by sorrow, who does not crave pleasures, and who is free from attachment, fear and anger, is called a sage of steady wisdom.
items.carry: Meet the good news and the bad news at the same level today.

items.sa:
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले
गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम् ।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं
चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम् ॥
items.en: From the forest of his matted hair the sacred waters flow, a great serpent hangs as a garland at his throat; to the drum's resounding damad-damad he dances his fierce tandava. May Shiva grant us what is auspicious.
items.carry: Bring real energy to your work; dance a little at the hard parts.

items.sa:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
items.en: Wherever the restless, unsteady mind wanders, bring it back from there and place it under the control of the Self.
items.carry: Each time your mind wanders in a focus block, simply bring it back.

items.sa:
महेशान्नापरो देवो महिम्नो नापरा स्तुतिः ।
अघोरान्नापरो मन्त्रो नास्ति तत्त्वं गुरोः परम् ॥
items.en: There is no god higher than Mahesha, no hymn higher than the Mahimna, no mantra higher than Aghora, no truth higher than the guru.
items.carry: Thank someone who taught you something today.

items.sa:
सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ ।
ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि ॥
items.en: Treating pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat alike, then engage in the battle; thus you will incur no sin.
items.carry: Take the next step with the same calm after a win or a loss.

items.sa: चैतन्यमात्मा ॥
items.en: Consciousness is the Self.
items.carry: Sit for one minute and simply notice that you are aware.

items.sa:
नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः ।
न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः ॥
items.en: Weapons do not cut the Self, fire does not burn it, water does not wet it, and the wind does not dry it.
items.carry: Keep in view the part of you that criticism cannot touch.

items.sa:
रत्नैः कल्पितमासनं हिमजलैः स्नानं च दिव्याम्बरं
नानारत्नविभूषितं मृगमदामोदाङ्कितं चन्दनम् ।
जातीचम्पकबिल्वपत्ररचितं पुष्पं च धूपं तथा
दीपं देव दयानिधे पशुपते हृत्कल्पितं गृह्यताम् ॥
items.en: A seat set with jewels, a bath of cool water, divine garments, sandal paste, flowers of jasmine, champaka and bilva, incense and a lamp: all of it imagined in my heart, Lord, I offer to you.
items.carry: You need nothing extra to offer today. Bring your attention.

items.sa:
शिवेति नामदावाग्नेर्महापातकपर्वताः ।
भस्मीभवन्त्यनायासात्सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः ॥
items.en: The name 'Shiva' is a wildfire: even mountains of great wrongdoing burn to ash without effort. This is true, truly true; there is no doubt.
items.carry: Begin with one auspicious word and let it clear the clutter in your head.

items.sa:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
items.tr:
Śrī guru caran saroj raj, nij manu mukuru sudhāri;
baranauṃ raghubar bimal jasu, jo dāyaku phal cāri.
items.en: With the dust of my guru's lotus feet I polish the mirror of my mind, then sing the spotless glory of Rama, which gives the four fruits of life.
items.carry: Clean the mirror first: clear your head before you begin.

items.sa:
क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते ।
क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप ॥
items.en: Do not yield to weakness, O Partha; it does not suit you. Shake off this petty faintness of heart and stand up, O scorcher of foes.
items.carry: Name the fear, then act in spite of it.

items.sa:
बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवन-कुमार ।
बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
items.tr:
Buddhihīn tanu jānike sumirauṃ pavan-kumār;
bal budhi bidyā dehu mohiṃ harahu kales bikār.
items.en: Knowing myself to be lacking in wisdom, I remember you, son of the wind. Grant me strength, wisdom and knowledge, and remove my afflictions and flaws.
items.carry: Ask for strength, then use it on the thing in front of you.

items.sa:
उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम् ।
सोत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम् ॥
items.en: Enthusiasm is strength, noble one; there is no strength greater than enthusiasm. For the enthusiastic, nothing in the world is hard to attain.
items.carry: Bring real energy to the first ten minutes; the rest follows.

items.sa:
दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते ।
सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हरे तेते ॥
items.tr:
Durgam kāj jagat ke jete,
sugam anugrah tumhare tete.
items.en: Every hard task in the world becomes easy with your grace.
items.carry: Pick the hardest task on the list and take only its first step.

items.sa:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून्भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् ।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥
items.en: Therefore arise and win glory; conquer your enemies and enjoy a prosperous kingdom. They have already been struck down by Me; be only the instrument, O Savyasachin.
items.carry: Do your part well and leave the outcome to the larger picture.

items.sa:
सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना ।
तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना ॥
items.tr:
Sab sukh lahai tumhārī saranā,
tum racchak kāhū ko ḍar nā.
items.en: All happiness comes to those who take your refuge; with you as protector, why fear anyone?
items.carry: Walk into the day without bracing for it.

items.sa:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा ।
निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः ॥
items.en: Offering all your actions to Me, with your mind fixed on the Self, free from hope and possessiveness, fight without fever.
items.carry: Work hard and keep the fever of anxiety out of it.

items.sa:
संकट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै ।
मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥
items.tr:
Saṅkaṭ teṃ Hanumān chuṛāvai,
man kram bacan dhyān jo lāvai.
items.en: Hanuman frees from trouble the one who keeps him in mind, in deed and in word.
items.carry: Let what you think, do and say today point the same way.

items.sa:
रामो विग्रहवान्धर्मः साधुः सत्यपराक्रमः ।
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानामिव वासवः ॥
items.en: Rama is dharma embodied: virtuous, truthful and valiant; king of the whole world as Indra is of the gods.
items.carry: Make decisions today that you would not need to hide.

items.src: Ramcharitmanas, Sundara Kanda, invocation shloka 3 · Tulsidas
items.sa:
अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं
दनुजवनकृशानुं ज्ञानिनामग्रगण्यम् ।
सकलगुणनिधानं वानराणामधीशं
रघुपतिप्रियभक्तं वातजातं नमामि ॥
items.en: I bow to the son of the wind: abode of matchless strength, with a body like a golden mountain, fire to the forest of demons, foremost among the wise, treasury of all virtues, lord of the vanaras, dear devotee of Rama.
items.carry: Strength and humility can live in one person. Practise both.

items.sa:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
items.en: Where there is Krishna, the lord of yoga, and Arjuna, the archer, there are prosperity, victory, well-being and firm policy: this is my conviction.
items.carry: Pair effort with trust: do the work, then let go.

items.sa:
भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै ।
महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै ॥
items.tr:
Bhūt pisāc nikaṭ nahiṃ āvai,
mahābīr jab nām sunāvai.
items.en: Ghosts and demons do not come near when the name of the mighty Hanuman is chanted.
items.carry: Chant one name whenever the old fears start talking.

items.sa:
संकट कटै मिटै सब पीरा ।
जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा ॥
items.tr:
Saṅkaṭ kaṭai miṭai sab pīrā,
jo sumirai Hanumat balabīrā.
items.en: Troubles are cut away and all pain disappears for one who remembers the brave and mighty Hanuman.
items.carry: When it gets heavy, remember: this too will be cut away.

items.sa:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
items.en: O Lord of the curved trunk and mighty body, with the brilliance of a million suns, make all my undertakings free of obstacles, always.
items.carry: Remove the first obstacle by simply starting.

items.sa:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते ।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
items.en: On this path no effort is wasted and no harm is done. Even a little of this dharma protects from great fear.
items.carry: A small start counts. Do ten minutes.

items.sa:
शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् ।
प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत्सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
items.en: One should meditate on the all-pervading one clad in white, moon-coloured, four-armed, with a serene face, for the stilling of all obstacles.
items.carry: Take one calm breath, then meet the day.

items.sa:
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन ।
बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् ॥
items.en: On this path the resolute intellect is one-pointed, O joy of the Kurus; the thoughts of the irresolute have many branches and no end.
items.carry: Choose one thing for this block and let the rest wait.

items.sa:
त्वमेव केवलं कर्ताऽसि ।
त्वमेव केवलं धर्ताऽसि ।
त्वमेव केवलं हर्ताऽसि ।
त्वमेव सर्वं खल्विदं ब्रह्मासि ।
त्वं साक्षादात्माऽसि नित्यम् ॥
items.en: You alone are the creator, you alone the sustainer, you alone the dissolver. You are all this, the Brahman. You are the eternal Self, directly seen.
items.carry: Treat what you start today as an offering.

items.sa:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ॥
items.en: Nothing in this world purifies like knowledge. One perfected in yoga finds it within oneself in time.
items.carry: Learn one thing properly today; time will do the rest.

items.sa:
विद्या ददाति विनयं विनयाद्याति पात्रताम् ।
पात्रत्वाद्धनमाप्नोति धनाद्धर्मं ततः सुखम् ॥
items.en: Knowledge gives humility; humility gives worthiness; worthiness brings wealth; wealth enables dharma, and from that comes happiness.
items.carry: Stay a student today. It is the surest way up.

items.sa:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः ।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
items.en: One who has faith, is devoted to it, and has mastered the senses gains knowledge; having gained knowledge, one quickly attains supreme peace.
items.carry: Give today's study your full, unhurried attention.

items.sa:
गजाननं भूतगणादिसेवितं कपित्थजम्बूफलसारभक्षितम् ।
उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारणं नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपङ्कजम् ॥
items.en: I bow at the lotus feet of Vighneshwara, the elephant-faced son of Uma, attended by hosts of spirits, who eats the essence of wood-apple and jambul fruit and brings an end to sorrow.
items.carry: Begin with gratitude for what is already working.

items.sa:
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
items.en: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is restless and hard to restrain; but it is held by practice and by detachment.
items.carry: Practice answers a restless mind. Repeat the block.

items.sa:
उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः ।
न हि सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः ॥
items.en: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by wishes. Deer do not walk into the mouth of a sleeping lion.
items.carry: Turn one wish into a scheduled block today.

items.sa:
मातृदेवो भव ।
पितृदेवो भव ।
आचार्यदेवो भव ।
अतिथिदेवो भव ॥
items.en: Let your mother be a god to you; let your father be a god to you; let your teacher be a god to you; let your guest be a god to you.
items.carry: Sit with someone at home and give them your full attention.

items.sa:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते ।
तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् ॥
items.en: One established in wisdom casts off both good and evil deeds here. So devote yourself to yoga; yoga is skill in action.
items.carry: Aim for skill, not speed. Do the next thing well.

items.sa:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥
items.en: Better is one's own duty, though imperfect, than another's duty well performed. Death in one's own duty is better; another's duty brings fear.
items.carry: Stop comparing paths. Make your own a little better today.

items.src: Guru Gita (Skanda Purana) · as commonly recited
items.sa:
गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुर्गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः ।
गुरुः साक्षात्परं ब्रह्म तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
items.en: The guru is Brahma, the guru is Vishnu, the guru is the god Maheshwara; the guru is the Supreme Brahman itself. Salutations to that revered guru.
items.carry: Thursday is Guruvar: thank, or learn from, one teacher today.

items.sa:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
items.en: You have a right to action alone, never to its fruits. Do not be the cause of the fruits of action, and do not be attached to inaction.
items.carry: Do the work for its own sake. Let the result arrive on its own.

items.sa:
शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं
विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम् ।
लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं
वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥
items.en: I bow to Vishnu: peaceful in form, resting on the serpent, lotus-navelled, lord of the gods; support of the universe, vast as the sky, cloud-hued, beautiful of limb; lord of Lakshmi, lotus-eyed, reached by yogis in meditation; remover of the fear of worldly life, the one Lord of all the worlds.
items.carry: Be as calm as the Vishnu in this verse when the day pulls at you.

items.sa:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
items.en: Whenever dharma declines, O Bharata, and adharma rises, then I send myself forth.
items.carry: When something right needs defending today, speak up a little.

items.sa:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् ।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥
items.en: To protect the good, to destroy evil-doers, and to establish dharma, I come into being age after age.
items.carry: Protect one good thing today: a person, an animal, a promise.

items.sa: यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः ॥
items.en: Where there is dharma, there is victory.
items.carry: Choose the right way even when it is the slower way.

items.sa:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
items.en: To those who worship Me alone, thinking of nothing else and always devoted, I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.
items.carry: Do the work wholeheartedly and trust the rest to be looked after.

items.sa:
श्रवणं कीर्तनं विष्णोः स्मरणं पादसेवनम् ।
अर्चनं वन्दनं दास्यं सख्यमात्मनिवेदनम् ॥
items.en: Hearing, chanting and remembering Vishnu; serving his feet; worshipping, bowing, serving, friendship, and surrendering oneself: the nine ways of devotion.
items.carry: Pick one of the nine today: listen, chant, remember, serve.

items.sa:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् ।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥
items.en: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, give, or practise as austerity, O Kaunteya, do it as an offering to Me.
items.carry: Treat today's ordinary tasks as an offering.

items.src: Manusmriti 8.15 · echoed in the Mahabharata, Vana Parva 313.128
items.sa:
धर्म एव हतो हन्ति धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः ।
तस्माद्धर्मो न हन्तव्यो मा नो धर्मो हतोऽवधीत् ॥
items.en: Dharma, when destroyed, destroys; dharma, when protected, protects. So dharma must not be destroyed, lest destroyed dharma destroy us.
items.carry: Keep one small promise exactly as you made it.

items.sa:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
items.en: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, that offering of the pure-hearted I accept.
items.carry: A small offering made with love is enough. Offer what you have.

items.src: Mahabharata, Vana Parva 313.117 (Gita Press numbering) · Yaksha Prashna
items.sa:
तर्कोऽप्रतिष्ठः श्रुतयो विभिन्ना नैको ऋषिर्यस्य मतं प्रमाणम् ।
धर्मस्य तत्त्वं निहितं गुहायां महाजनो येन गतः स पन्थाः ॥
items.en: Argument has no firm footing, the scriptures differ, and no single sage's word settles it. The truth of dharma lies hidden in the cave (of the heart); the path is the one the great have walked.
items.carry: When unsure, ask what the people you most respect would do.

items.sa:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
items.en: From whom all beings arise, by whom all this is pervaded: worshipping Him through one's own work, a person attains perfection.
items.carry: Let your work be your worship today.

items.sa:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
items.en: Abandoning all other duties, take refuge in Me alone. I will free you from all sins; do not grieve.
items.carry: Put down one burden you have been carrying alone.

items.sa:
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके ।
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
items.en: O auspicious of all that is auspicious, benevolent one, accomplisher of every aim, giver of refuge, three-eyed Gauri, Narayani: salutations to you.
items.carry: Begin with Maa's name; ask for steadiness, not only success.

items.sa:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
items.en: I am all-devouring death and the source of what is yet to be. Among feminine qualities I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, steadfastness and patience.
items.carry: Grow one of these today: memory, steadiness or patience.

items.sa:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
items.en: To the Goddess who dwells in all beings in the form of strength: salutations to her, again and again.
items.carry: Spend your strength where it counts: the one hard thing.

items.sa:
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः ।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् ।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ॥
items.en: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadiness in knowledge and yoga, giving, self-control, sacrifice, study of scripture, austerity, straightforwardness; non-violence, truth, freedom from anger, renunciation, peace, not speaking ill of others, compassion for beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty, steadiness.
items.carry: Pick one quality from this list and practise it before night.

items.sa:
सर्वस्वरूपे सर्वेशे सर्वशक्तिसमन्विते ।
भयेभ्यस्त्राहि नो देवि दुर्गे देवि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
items.en: O Devi, in the form of all, ruler of all, endowed with all power: protect us from all fears. O Durga, salutations to you.
items.carry: Walk through one fear today. You are protected.

items.sa:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
items.en: One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pain and pleasure, and forgiving.
items.carry: Show kindness to something small that cannot repay you.

items.sa:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु बुद्धिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
items.en: To the Goddess who dwells in all beings in the form of intelligence: salutations to her, again and again.
items.carry: Think before you react, once today.

items.src: Mahabharata, Anushasana Parva 13.117.37–38 (chapter 116 in older editions)
items.sa:
अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाहिंसा परो दमः ।
अहिंसा परमं दानमहिंसा परमस्तपः ॥
अहिंसा परमो यज्ञस्तथाहिंसा परं बलम् ।
अहिंसा परमं मित्रमहिंसा परमं सुखम् ॥
items.en: Non-violence is the highest dharma, the highest self-restraint, the highest gift, the highest austerity, the highest sacrifice, the highest strength, the highest friend, the highest happiness.
items.carry: Be gentle in word and deed with every living thing today.

items.sa:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु क्षान्तिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
items.en: To the Goddess who dwells in all beings in the form of forbearance: salutations to her, again and again.
items.carry: Be patient once today where you would normally snap.

items.sa:
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
items.en: The wise see with an equal eye a learned and humble brahmin, a cow, an elephant, a dog, and an outcaste.
items.carry: Treat everyone you meet today, human or animal, with the same respect.

items.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम् ।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥
items.en: O Jatavedas (Agni), bring to me Lakshmi: golden-hued, deer-like in grace, adorned with garlands of gold and silver, moon-like, radiant.
items.carry: Prosperity follows steadiness. Keep today's habits.

items.src: Mahabharata, Udyoga Parva, chapter 33 · Vidura Niti
items.sa:
एको धर्मः परं श्रेयः क्षमैका शान्तिरुत्तमा ।
विद्यैका परमा तृप्तिरहिंसैका सुखावहा ॥
items.en: Dharma alone is the highest good; forbearance alone brings the highest peace; knowledge alone is the highest contentment; non-violence alone brings happiness.
items.carry: Forgive one small thing today and feel how much lighter it is.

items.sa:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु दयारूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
items.en: To the Goddess who dwells in all beings in the form of compassion: salutations to her, again and again.
items.carry: Feed or help one stray creature today. That is compassion in action.

items.sa:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥
items.en: Vigour, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from malice and from excessive pride: these belong to one born with a divine endowment, O Bharata.
items.carry: Show vigour without pride today.

items.sa:
देवराजसेव्यमानपावनाङ्घ्रिपङ्कजं
व्यालयज्ञसूत्रमिन्दुशेखरं कृपाकरम् ।
नारदादियोगिवृन्दवन्दितं दिगम्बरं
काशिकापुराधिनाथकालभैरवं भजे ॥
items.en: I worship Kalabhairava, Lord of Kashi: his holy lotus feet served by the king of the gods; wearing a serpent as the sacred thread, the moon on his brow, ocean of compassion; praised by Narada and the company of yogis; sky-clad.
items.carry: Respect time today: begin on time and end on time.

items.sa:
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः ।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥
items.en: I am Time, the mighty destroyer of the worlds, here to gather in all beings. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the opposing armies will live.
items.carry: Time is the one resource you cannot earn back. Spend it on purpose.

items.sa: उद्यमो भैरवः ॥
items.en: Udyama, the upsurge of effort, is Bhairava.
items.carry: Start the first block before you feel ready.

items.sa:
जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च ।
तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि ॥
items.en: For one who is born, death is certain, and for one who has died, birth is certain. So you should not grieve over what cannot be avoided.
items.carry: Let go of what cannot be changed and use the energy on what can.

items.sa:
कालभैरवाष्टकं पठन्ति ये मनोहरं
ज्ञानमुक्तिसाधनं विचित्रपुण्यवर्धनम् ।
शोकमोहदैन्यलोभकोपतापनाशनं
ते प्रयान्ति कालभैरवाङ्घ्रिसन्निधिं ध्रुवम् ॥
items.en: Those who recite this beautiful Kalabhairava Ashtakam, a means to knowledge and liberation that increases merit and destroys grief, delusion, wretchedness, greed, anger and torment, surely reach the feet of Kalabhairava.
items.carry: Drop one of these today: grief, delusion, greed or anger.

items.src: Mahabharata, Udyoga Parva, chapter 33 · Vidura Niti
items.sa:
षड्दोषाः पुरुषेणेह हातव्या भूतिमिच्छता ।
निद्रा तन्द्री भयं क्रोध आलस्यं दीर्घसूत्रता ॥
items.en: A person who wants to prosper must give up six faults: too much sleep, drowsiness, fear, anger, laziness and procrastination.
items.carry: Pick the one that is yours and beat it for a single day.

items.sa:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते ।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते ॥
क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहः सम्मोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः ।
स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति ॥
items.en: Dwelling on objects of the senses breeds attachment; attachment breeds desire; desire breeds anger. From anger comes delusion, from delusion loss of memory, from that the ruin of intelligence, and with that one is lost.
items.carry: Notice where your attention keeps going, and cut the chain at its first link.

items.src: Mahabharata, Vana Parva 313.116 (Gita Press numbering) · Yaksha Prashna
items.sa:
अहन्यहनि भूतानि गच्छन्तीह यमालयम् ।
शेषाः स्थावरमिच्छन्ति किमाश्चर्यमतः परम् ॥
items.en: Day after day beings go to the abode of Yama, yet those who remain wish to live forever. What greater wonder is there?
items.carry: Do today what you will be glad to have done.

items.sa:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
items.en: Words that cause no distress, that are truthful, pleasant and beneficial, and the regular practice of one's own study, are called the austerity of speech.
items.carry: Speak once today in a way that is true, kind and useful.

items.sa:
सर्वं परवशं दुःखं सर्वमात्मवशं सुखम् ।
एतद्विद्यात्समासेन लक्षणं सुखदुःखयोः ॥
items.en: All that depends on others is sorrow; all that is within one's own control is happiness. Know this in brief as the mark of happiness and sorrow.
items.carry: Spend today on what is in your control.

items.sa:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः ।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥
items.en: Threefold is this gate to hell, destroying the self: desire, anger and greed. Therefore one should give up these three.
items.carry: Pause before the next craving, snap or grab.

items.sa:
नीलाञ्जनसमाभासं रविपुत्रं यमाग्रजम् ।
छायामार्तण्डसम्भूतं तं नमामि शनैश्चरम् ॥
items.en: I bow to Shani, the slow-moving one, dark as blue collyrium, son of the Sun, elder brother of Yama, born of Chhaya and Martanda.
items.carry: Slow, steady, patient: do one thing with Shani's discipline.

items.sa:
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
items.en: O Partha, neither in this world nor the next is there destruction for such a person. No one who does good, my friend, ever comes to grief.
items.carry: Do one good thing today even if no one sees it.

items.sa: शरीरमाद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनम् ॥
items.en: The body is indeed the first instrument of dharma.
items.carry: Train, eat and rest as if your body were the instrument of your purpose.
